title: Question about tumors: do you have these?
content: I have known about a tumor in my pituitary gland since about 06/07, and now have been told that I have one on my adrenal gland. Does anyone else have a history of these? How does this relate to mall world/dreaming: in my dreams last night, I was looking at different apartments and houses to move into, and I sneezed something out of my nose, which was like a tiny battery or grain of rice, and this has never been a thing before. Anybody else? Just me?
